name: Untangle
description: Untangle the graph: drag the dots until no edges cross, on a flat 2D board or around a 3D globe (great-circle arcs). 30 levels per mode that unlock as you solve them, progress and best times kept on your device, reset any time. In VR: grab dots with the trigger (laser or tip), hold, turn and scale the globe with one hand while the other moves dots, a laser-reachable level bar, haptics. Procedural and replicated, with game sounds and quiet puzzle music - board pose, level and readouts as flow nodes.
